body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Motorola showcased a new intuitive, customizable and vibrant touch tablet phone 'MOTOSURF A3100' at CES 2009.
This high-speed, 3G device grants immediate access to content through an impressive personalized icon-based touch screen, helping you achieve the ultimate work-life balance.
MOTOSURF A3100 is expected to be available in multiple markets in Q1 2009, including Asia and Latin America.
